0212__L4_MA1_81__DAA01D50.mp3.asr_text: Heads down, 2nd Division. This is the California. You've got incoming artillery support. Courtesy of the U.S. Navy.
0212__L4_MA1_81__DAA01D50.mp3.translation: 第二师，注意隐蔽。这里是加利福尼亚号。美国海军给你们送来的炮火支援马上就到。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 第二师，注意隐蔽。这里是加利福尼亚号。美国海军给你们送来的炮火支援马上就到。

0213__L4_Sul_83__1AB2F685.mp3.asr_text: Fall back, Marines! We don't want to be here when those shells hit!
0213__L4_Sul_83__1AB2F685.mp3.translation: 后撤，弟兄们！炮弹落下来时，谁也别留在这儿！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 后撤，弟兄们！炮弹落下来时，谁也别留在这儿！

0214__L4_Pol_90__C5C69B3E.mp3.asr_text: You gotta be kidding me, sir.

0215__L4_Sul_77__19367BEA.mp3.asr_text: Miller, grab the bazooka and use it on that armor. Buy us some time.
0215__L4_Sul_77__19367BEA.mp3.translation: 米勒，拿巴祖卡打那些坦克，给我们争取点时间。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 米勒，拿巴祖卡打那些坦克，给我们争取点时间。

0217__L4_Sul_18__0F077FB1.mp3.asr_text: Keep firing! Make every round count!
0217__L4_Sul_18__0F077FB1.mp3.translation: 继续开火！每一发都要打准！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 继续开火！每一发都要打准！

0218__L4_Pol_14__B858344A.mp3.asr_text: Oh, that's just great! It's dark! Now what? We gonna scare them off with shadow puppets?
0218__L4_Pol_14__B858344A.mp3.translation: 真是太好了，天黑了！现在该怎么办？打个手影吓跑他们？

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 真是太好了，天黑了！现在该怎么办？打个手影吓跑他们？

0220__L4_Sul_35__1246EA6C.mp3.asr_text: Sniper in the trees ahead, stay sharp!
0220__L4_Sul_35__1246EA6C.mp3.translation: 前面的树上有狙击手，小心！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 前面的树上有狙击手，小心！

0223__L4_MA1_1__4078EDB6.mp3.asr_text: Nearly, sir. Give me a couple more minutes. Come on. Come on!
0223__L4_MA1_1__4078EDB6.mp3.translation: 快好了，长官。再给我几分钟。快啊，快啊！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 快好了，长官。再给我几分钟。快啊，快啊！

0224__L4_MA3_45__A3C77296.mp3.asr_text: Enemy mortars took out most of our men!
0224__L4_MA3_45__A3C77296.mp3.translation: 敌人的迫击炮把我们大半人都炸没了！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 敌人的迫击炮把我们大半人都炸没了！

0225__L4_Sul_23__1075E2CB.mp3.asr_text: Outstanding, Marines! That looks like the last of them.
0225__L4_Sul_23__1075E2CB.mp3.translation: 干得漂亮，弟兄们！应该全干掉了。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 干得漂亮，弟兄们！应该全干掉了。

0226__L4_Sul_15__0EDD392E.mp3.asr_text: Stay down! Wait for more star shells!
0226__L4_Sul_15__0EDD392E.mp3.translation: 趴着别动！等下一轮照明弹！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 趴着别动！等下一轮照明弹！

0227__L4_Ma1_11__CEAE30F7.mp3.asr_text: I see them! They're in those craters!
0227__L4_Ma1_11__CEAE30F7.mp3.translation: 看见他们了！在那些弹坑里！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 看见他们了！在那些弹坑里！

0229__L4_Pol_60__C0A81161.mp3.asr_text: Yeah! Nice shooting there, Eagle Eye!
0229__L4_Pol_60__C0A81161.mp3.translation: 漂亮！这一发够准，神射手！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 漂亮！这一发够准，神射手！

0230__L4_Sul_63__17494547.mp3.asr_text: Heads up! Enemy grenades from above!
0230__L4_Sul_63__17494547.mp3.translation: 小心！上面有人往下扔手雷！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 小心！上面有人往下扔手雷！

0232__L4_Sul_79__1952AAEC.mp3.asr_text: Radio to California, we need naval support now!
0232__L4_Sul_79__1952AAEC.mp3.translation: 呼叫加利福尼亚号，我们马上需要舰炮支援！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 呼叫加利福尼亚号，我们马上需要舰炮支援！

0233__L4_Sul_8__091D55AA.mp3.asr_text: Quick, open fire! Before they run back into cover!
0233__L4_Sul_8__091D55AA.mp3.translation: 快开火！别让他们缩回掩体！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 快开火！别让他们缩回掩体！

0234__L4_Sul_55__15B09BAA.mp3.asr_text: Miller! Grab that bazooka and use it on that bunker! Better hope to hell there's a round in it!
0234__L4_Sul_55__15B09BAA.mp3.translation: 米勒！拿巴祖卡轰那个碉堡！但愿里面还有一发！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 米勒！拿巴祖卡轰那个碉堡！但愿里面还有一发！

0236__L4_MA3_46__A3D58A17.mp3.asr_text: Some of them made it through into the bunker!

0239__L4_Sul_26__10A0294E.mp3.asr_text: Our boys are down there. Looks like they could use some help. Give them a hand, Marines. Hut!
0239__L4_Sul_26__10A0294E.mp3.translation: 咱们的人在下面。看样子需要帮忙。弟兄们，支援他们，快！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 咱们的人在下面。看样子需要帮忙。弟兄们，支援他们，快！

0240__L4_Pol_40__BD3E6023.mp3.asr_text: Landing site's just over these dunes, Sergeant.
0240__L4_Pol_40__BD3E6023.mp3.translation: 中士，翻过这些沙丘就是登陆点。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 中士，翻过这些沙丘就是登陆点。

0241__L4_Sul_61__172D1645.mp3.asr_text: Miller, you're with me. Rest of you topside.
0241__L4_Sul_61__172D1645.mp3.translation: 米勒，跟我来。其他人留在上面。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 米勒，跟我来。其他人留在上面。

0242__L4_Sul_64__17575CC8.mp3.asr_text: Keep moving through the bunker. We need to reach that line.
0242__L4_Sul_64__17575CC8.mp3.translation: 继续穿过碉堡，我们要赶到防线。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 继续穿过碉堡，我们要赶到防线。

0243__L4_Pol_75__C2A35F85.mp3.asr_text: This is looking bad, Sergeant! How much longer we gotta hold out here?
0243__L4_Pol_75__C2A35F85.mp3.translation: 中士，情况不妙啊！还要在这儿撑多久？

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 中士，情况不妙啊！还要在这儿撑多久？

0244__L4_Pol_80__C411C29F.mp3.asr_text: This could be it, boys! Go down swinging!
0244__L4_Pol_80__C411C29F.mp3.translation: 弟兄们，可能就到这儿了！死也要拉几个垫背的！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 弟兄们，可能就到这儿了！死也要拉几个垫背的！

0245__L4_Sul_51__15783DA6.mp3.asr_text: We gotta take out that MG Bunker. Run to cover and work your way up. Try to get close.
0245__L4_Sul_51__15783DA6.mp3.translation: 需要端掉那个机枪堡。借着掩体往前走，尽量靠近。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 需要端掉那个机枪堡。借着掩体往前走，尽量靠近。

0246__L4_Sul_65__17657449.mp3.asr_text: This way! We've got positions at the line, but we need more men!
0246__L4_Sul_65__17657449.mp3.translation: 这边！前沿阵地还在，可人手不够！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 这边！前沿阵地还在，可人手不够！

0247__L4_Sul_2__08C8C8A4.mp3.translation: 陆战队员们听着，咱们偏离预定位置了！要从这向北，赶去主力登陆滩头。都别轻举妄动，等照明弹升空再行动！通讯兵！电台到底怎么回事？！
0247__L4_Sul_2__08C8C8A4.mp3.note: ASR因超长跳过。未使用AM旧稿补写，待补识别或听音。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 陆战队员们听着，咱们偏离预定位置了！要从这向北，赶去主力登陆滩头。都别轻举妄动，等照明弹升空再行动！通讯兵！电台到底怎么回事？！

0248__L4_Sul_89__1B07838B.mp3.asr_text: Now, Polonsky, we take that mountain.
0248__L4_Sul_89__1B07838B.mp3.translation: 波隆斯基，接下来把那座山拿下。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 波隆斯基，接下来把那座山拿下。

0249__L4_MA1_76__D931BA36.mp3.asr_text: Aw hell, they've got tanks! Enemy armor on the horizon!
0249__L4_MA1_76__D931BA36.mp3.translation: 操，他们有坦克！敌军坦克就在前面！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 操，他们有坦克！敌军坦克就在前面！

0251__L4_Pol_9__DD1712EE.mp3.asr_text: Enemy on the east flank, Sergeant!

0252__L4_Sul_13__0EC10A2C.mp3.asr_text: On the double, get into that trench!

0253__L4_Sul_29__10CA6FD1.mp3.asr_text: Mine's in the water! Keep away from the shoreline!

0254__L4_Sul_52__15865527.mp3.asr_text: Okay, stay in cover. Flank the bunker from the right side.
0254__L4_Sul_52__15865527.mp3.translation: 隐蔽好，从右边绕到碉堡侧面。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 隐蔽好，从右边绕到碉堡侧面。

0255__L4_Sul_62__173B2DC6.mp3.asr_text: They're executing our men? Hell, this stops now! Get in there and pull those boys out!
0255__L4_Sul_62__173B2DC6.mp3.translation: 他们在处决咱们的人？妈的，不能再让他们杀了！冲进去救人！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 他们在处决咱们的人？妈的，不能再让他们杀了！冲进去救人！

0256__L4_Sul_67__1781A34B.mp3.asr_text: Word is the enemy has launched a hell of a counter-assault. Looks like they're going to be coming right through here. We need to hold this position, Marines.
0256__L4_Sul_67__1781A34B.mp3.translation: 听说敌人发起了大反攻，看样子会直接从这里杀过来。弟兄们，必须守住这个阵地。
0256__L4_Sul_67__1781A34B.mp3.note: ASR与AM旧稿差异明显，本条以ASR为准，没有补入旧稿提到的全岛撤退等内容。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 听说敌人发起了大反攻，看样子会直接从这里杀过来。弟兄们，必须守住这个阵地。

0257__L4_MA3_44__A3B95B15.mp3.asr_text: The mortar fire finally slacked off, but those goddamn MGs have got the whole beach covered, and we can't get near them!
0257__L4_MA3_44__A3B95B15.mp3.translation: 迫击炮总算消停了，可那些混蛋机枪封死了整片海滩，我们根本靠不过去！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 迫击炮总算消停了，可那些混蛋机枪封死了整片海滩，我们根本靠不过去！
